name: dsh-crawler
description: 通用网页爬虫 pawl：http/crawl4ai/反检测浏览器三引擎；单页自由提取(文字/图片/表格/PDF/电子书)、批量断点续爬、整站BFS、CF自动过验证。侧边栏「爬虫」卡全量设置(网页列表/检索词模糊匹配/存放格式/存储路径)，6 个 agent 工具。
dshHostDeps: bridged: node_modules/@deepseek-ai/* are symlinks to the dsh CLI copies (single instance, no shadowing). Do NOT run pnpm install here — it would vendor real copies and break the bridges.
